paragraphs: Per the file, creating new stake accts whose delegation is below (per the file) 1 sol will no longer be possible. Per the file, dapps which create stake accts must acct for minimum delegation. Per the file, ultimately the Stake Program (per the file) is the arbiter of (per the file) correctness and will safely (per the file) reject invalid state transitions. Per the file, merging stake accts is always allowed, even (per the file) if the merge destination fails to rise above 1 sol.

Per the file, meta.rent_exempt_reserve is now deprecated (per the file) and dapps should calculate rent- exemption via (per the file) Rent. Per the file, this is a consequence (per the file) of rent reduction itself (per the file) rather than this SIMD specifically. Per the file, sysvars no longer need (per the file) to be provided for (per the file) Stake Program operations, reducing tx size and allowing CPI (per the file) callers to also no longer require these accts in their own interfaces. Per the file, updated Stake Program instruction builders is to be released after BPF (per the file) Stake v5.0.0 is live (per the file) on all networks.
